test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: River Ken is one of the major rivers of the Bundelkhand region of central India and flows through two states, Madhya Pradesh and _________.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ken River** is one of the major rivers of the **Bundelkhand region** of central India.
 
• It flows across **Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• It is a **tributary **of the **Yamuna**.
